segments.text: Returning to case CEDAR-TRAINING: the second owner reports normal drinking, contradicting the earlier account of drinking less water. The clinician now reports systolic blood pressure of 105 mmHg. They said fluids had continued. No vasopressor was recorded. Outcome remains unknown.

Separate classroom ultrasound exercise: first identify the probe connector, then check that the cable is not trapped beneath the cart. The trainer did not identify the machine model. This exercise is not a verified operating procedure for a clinical machine.
